blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FIDD Terms section 12 permit Fidelity to block addresses and freeze associated FIDD. The verified Ethereum implementation (MintableToken behind UUPS proxy 0x7c135549504245b5eae64fc0e99fa5ebabb8e35d; implementation 0x8ae9cb3d9095da33555494110f567e3d974c6753) enforces this on-chain: restrictTransfers(address) is gated by TOKEN_TRANSFER_CONTROLLER_ROLE and transfer, transferFrom, approvals and mint/burn apply whenNotRestricted checks to the named holder; pause() is gated by PAUSER_ROLE. At Ethereum block 26224764 (2026-10-19), TOKEN_TRANSFER_CONTROLLER_ROLE had one member, 0x884970cbA7985e903BcF96B062FD226dB3b66a6A; PAUSER_ROLE had one member, 0x49d2617E57a1eA5d70F3863297e416d81cE0acDE; paused() was false; and getTransferRestrictionCount() returned 124. Ethereum holds 100% of FIDD supply. The assigned controller and 124 restricted addresses establish a direct Yes.
